constraints: If decoded is omitted, the command overwrites toDecode in place with the decoded value instead of writing to a separate parameter.
See BASE64 ENCODE for details on the Base64 vs. Base64URL format distinction (selected here via the trailing *).

overloadMerges.note: toDecode is documented/arrow-marked as inout ('<->': input encoded value, and also the output slot when decoded is omitted); decoded is a pure output. The draft parser had defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.name: toDecode
params.description: Base64/Base64URL-encoded value to decode; overwritten in place with the decoded value if decoded is omitted.

params.name: decoded
params.description: Receives the decoded value, if supplied.
If present, decode using the Base64URL variant instead of standard Base64.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Decodes a Base64/Base64URL-encoded text or blob value from toDecode, either into decoded or back into toDecode itself if decoded is omitted.
